user.title: Set up BrewSense
user.description: Pick the power sensor and switch of your coffee maker. The timing values can be changed later under Configure.

data_description.brew_threshold: Power draw at or above this value is treated as brewing.
data_description.seconds_per_cup: Brew time per cup, used to estimate the number of cups.
data_description.drip_delay: Time after brewing ends before the coffee counts as ready.
data_description.ready_linger: How long coffee stays available after the machine is switched off.
